writeup: Woot has the new EPOS ADAPT 160T ANC USB-C headset (MPN 1000221, UPC 840064400220) for $24.99. It is Microsoft Teams certified, with active noise cancelling and a fold-away boom mic. Macondo Networks lists the matching EPOS ADAPT 160T ANC USB-C Teams headset, matched by MPN 1000221 and UPC 0840064400220, at $109.20 and shows it in stock. PCNation has the same factory-fresh 1000221 model in stock at $109.43, and Beach Audio has the brand-new factory-sealed MS Teams version at $121.22. That is 77 percent below the lowest verified store price and saves about $84. Woot showed 3+ left with a limit of three per customer.
